snippet.title: Farming Simulator 26: Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Farming Simulator 26 is coming to Nintendo Switch and mobile devices on May 19th, bringing a new challenge system to virtual farmers who want a bit more structure without giving up the relaxed pace the series is known for.

🛒 There's more in our shop!
► https://www.farming-simulator.com/buy-now.php

👨‍🌾 Learn how to play with the Farming Simulator Academy!
► https://farming-simulator.com/academy
